statement: The evac shelter B-05 sits beside a road next to Codyville Plantation, with open fields to the west and forest to the northwest
A dumpsite in the field southwest of the shelter holds piles of scrap and junk: paper wrappers, plastic bags and sheets, bottles, aluminum cans, string, a small tin can, flyers and a gallon jug
The small tin can at the dumpsite is steel with a level 1 boiling quality, so it can heat liquids
The makeshift pot recipe needs 1 sheet metal plus a tool with hammering 2, and cannot be crafted in the dark
The homemade polehammer recipe needs a spear shaft, a hammer or makeshift polehammer, 3 nails and cutting and hammering tools; the survivor lacks the hammer and nails

Ferns in the forest give fresh fiddleheads (13 kcal each, perishable in 2 days, can cause food poisoning raw, better cooked); foraging the underbrush also gave a stick, plant fiber, a large rock and a field stone
Foraging the forest yields wild garlic seeds, and a sassafras tree near the shelter yielded 2 sassafras roots
Wild animals live near the shelter (wild turkeys in the forest; fox, opossum, feral pigeon and a calico cat in the fields), a possible meat source
A zapper zombie was spotted about 60 tiles to the southeast of the dumpsite field; safe mode warns of it
The survivor's name was corrected to Timothy Lowery after matching the initial and current character screens (earlier read as Adkins)
Plan: establish sustainable food and cooking, needing a cooking vessel and calorie supply
The game was saved and quit to the main menu, listing worlds Freemont and Rossiter; the game was not reloaded to verify the save
